name: hitlist-desktop
description: Desktop shell for HitList — spawns api/'s own jar locally (SQLite, no server) and shows web/'s own build in a window.

scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:jar && pnpm run prepare:jre && electron-builder
scripts.test: node --test test.auth.js test.backup.js test.restore.js test.dataDir.js test.cliqAlerts.js test.cliqInbox.js test.cliqPush.js test.updater.js test.installer.js
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run prepare:jar && pnpm run prepare:jre && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: pnpm run prepare:jar && pnpm run prepare:jre:win && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build:linux: pnpm run prepare:jar && pnpm run prepare:jre:linux && electron-builder --linux --x64
